caseNameFull: Lofton v. Douglas, Secretary of the Air Force
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Yeag-ley, Kevin T. Maroney and Samuel L. Strother for respondents.

opinions.text: The motion to substitute Dudley C. Sharp in the place of James H. Douglas as a party respondent is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.
